paragraphs: A simple and clean Jekyll theme for academics.

Originally, al-folio was based on the \folio theme (published by Lia Bogoev and under the MIT license). Since then, it got a full re-write of the styles and many additional cool features. The emphasis is on whitespace, transparency, and academic usage: theme demo.
features: Your publications page is generated automatically from your BibTex bibliography. Simply edit bibliography/papers.bib. You can also add new .bib files and customize the look of your publications however you like by…
Keep meta-information about your co-authors in data/coauthors.yml and Jekyll will insert links to their webpages automatically.

This Jekyll theme implements collections to let you break up your work into categories. The example is divided into news and projects, but easily revamp this into apps, short stories, courses, or whatever your creative…
To do this, edit the collections in the config.yml file, create a corresponding folder, and create a landing page for your collection, similar to pages/projects.md.
